text:
mohit: heads up — noticed a big spike in remote_write queue length from ap-sg GPU fleet, lots of 504/timeout errors and duplicate series churn. looks different from usual relabel flaps.

riley: on it. which metrics are spiking?

mohit: `prometheus.remote_write_queue_length` up to ~1200, p95 write latency jumped to 8s. logs show a lot of connection timeouts to the cortex ingesters. sample from prom logs:
```
level=warn component=remote_write msg="send failed" err="dial tcp 10.23.45.67:9009: i/o timeout"
level=error component=queue msg="send chunk failed"
```

ada: also saw NAT gateway conntrack around the same time — `conntrack -S` counters near the limit on ap-sg natgw. ephemeral ports probably saturated.

sara: if ephemeral ports run out you get four-tuple collisions and exporters keep reconnecting -> same exporter shows up with new pod labels when it restarts -> cardinality spike. saw duplicate series coming from `gpu_exporter` with varying `pod` suffixes.

prometheus-bot: :warning: alert fired: remote_write_queue_length (cluster=ap-sg) > 500

riley: quick mitigations we can apply now: 1) relabel exporters to drop pod-specific labels, 2) increase conntrack on the natgw, 3) add short-term rate limiting in `remote_write` queue_config to stop tail latency.

mohit: relabel snippet I tested locally to drop pod_name and node_uid (keeps export stable):
```
relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_name]
    regex: (.+)
    action: replace
    target_label: pod_name
  - action: labeldrop
    regex: pod_name|pod_template_hash|pod_uuid
```

ada: conntrack bump I ran on one natgw: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=200000` and `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established=432000`. pod churn reduced and connections stopped being reset.

sara: another long-term fix: give each node an egress IP pool (SNAT per node) or enable egress autoscaling so ephemeral ports don't get contended across many pods. also consider hostNetwork for exporters on GPU nodes.

riley: small config change for Prometheus remote_write queue we rolled out to staging:
```
remote_write:
  - url: https://cortex.example/api/v1/push
    queue_config:
      max_samples_per_send: 500
      max_shards: 8
      batch_send_deadline: 10s
    backoff_config:
      max_delay: 60s
```
this reduced burst pressure while conntrack was being adjusted.

mohit: FYI also disabled `honor_labels` on that remote_write (set to false) so external labels don't overwrite our relabeling. prevented a couple of label collisions.

engbot: assigning @riley to run conntrack bump across ap-sg natgw pool and to push the relabel patch to prod. ETA 30m. :thumbsup:

riley: patched relabel to prod and bumped conntrack on both natgws. monitoring dashboards show queue length decaying.

prometheus-bot: :white_check_mark: alert resolved: remote_write_queue_length (cluster=ap-sg)

mohit: p95 remote_write latency down ~60%, cardinality growth stopped. follow-up items: document exporter relabel standard, add egress capacity autoscale runbook, and add an SLO for remote_write p99. I'll open a ticket (#1234).

sara: great work — recommend we add an onboarding checklist for new exporters: relabel policy + prefer hostNetwork/egress-ip.

mohit: agreed. thanks everyone :sparkles:
